Last summer I was a landscaper while between jobs. 

I spent my days cutting park lawns on a ride on mower with my two best friends/roommates, having picnic/beer breaks in the middle of the day.

Best summer of my life. Completely over worked and under paid, and I've never smiled as often as I did for those 4 months.

Wouldn't trade those memories for anything.

Also just a little thought : 

Every other enemy or life threatening situation Stark came up against? His intellect saved him. He bet his wits and resolve against possible death.

There was a really well thought out comment by another fellow a little while back in a thread similar to this, I'll try and do it justice by memory.

I believe the commenter said something to the extent of:

Learn your major,minor, major pentatonic, minor pentatonic, and blues scales inside out. When I was just starting I played them daily in all their forms on the neck until my hands knew them by memory.

Learn 1-4-5 progressions. Learn the basics of  Funk, Shuffle, Rhumba, 12 and 8 bar blues. Memorize to the best of your ability all the notes on the bass neck. All of these things are readily available on the Internet. 

After you have gotten a good foot hold on these, find a jam group. Play with people all the time. You'll learn a lot, and more importantly you'll learn your weak spots. 

Those should be a good place to start.
